projection.authority: Projection only certifies the numeric relation at the sample. It proves no future clock-rate, drift, suspend, physical resolution or wall-time equivalence. Enclosing original global pre/post/delegation/output/terminal and external caller gates remain authoritative.
projection.clock_failure: Expired/unrepresentable projections are UNKNOWN/incomplete. Verifier computes its projection outside the mathematical ValueError-rejection try, so a projection error is not counted as word rejection.
projection.custody: Native global callable, exact type-int clock ID, process-local perf callable, nextafter/isfinite and original float ratio descriptor are captured in function keyword defaults and compared directly to original module endpoints before/after sampling/final gate. Trusted cold caller must retain full code/default/kwdefault/cell/module/class/MRO/object/native custody. No injected arbitrary clock or no-op guard.
projection.exact_bound: Lower the local float sample by math.nextafter toward negative infinity. Form the rational sum with the integer-nanosecond remainder. float.as_integer_ratio gives exact numerators/denominators; cross-products verify the returned local deadline is no later than that rational bound. A failed finite/bound/expired check raises TimeoutError, never renews a budget.
projection.producer_pair: Original producer2 receives a synthetic same-process local began and deadline. Deadline is evaluated as began+20.0 and that exact equality and rational no-later bound are checked after optional downward correction. Synthetic began is not the coordinator global begin and is never a resource epoch.
projection.sampling: Native process-local perf is sampled before native global CLOCK_MONOTONIC. Remaining global integer interval is positive and at most the unchanged joint interval. No shared perf epoch is assumed.
